name: Treedashing (Faunal)
body:
Your limbs shift subtly, allowing you to move through the branches of the forest like an ape or a squirrel.

Prerequisite(s): Bond of Fauna

Benefit(s): You may move at your base land speed when moving through a sufficiently dense forest canopy or similar terrain. You cannot run while treedashing, and you can only charge foes by dropping on them. In addition, you gain a +4 racial bonus on Climb checks made to climb trees.

Call of the Wild, Book 1 – The Druid. © 2017 d20pfsrd.com Publishing; Author: Kalen Tessmann
